description:
Title: Work Accident

Create a process that helps in gathering information about work accidents (and almost work accidents):
For insured gainful employment, a work accident is considered to be an accident that occurs in the following circumstances, by way of example:
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the insured employment
* when working from home
* on the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work, to lunch or on the way home, whereby carpools are also protected
* for training sessions that serve to provide specific professional knowledge, whereby an accident on to way to or from the training centre is considered a work accident
* on the direct route from home, or from the workplace or training centre to a doctor and back, if this interrupts the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work or the route home (the doctor's visit must be notified to the employer in advance)
* on the way to or from the workplace or training centre with the purpose of taking a child to or collecting them from a childcare facility, a daycare facility, external care or a school, insofar as they have a supervisory responsibility for the child
* when making use of advocacy groups or professional associations (e.g. Chamber of Labour, trade union federation, guild etc.)

For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, an accident is considered to be a work accident if, amongst other things
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the school or university education or the compulsory kindergarten year that forms the basis of the insurance
* when taking part in a school event or school-related event 
* on the direct route from the child's place of residence or permanent accommodation to kindergarten or a school visit or on the way home
* when performing a practical task prescribed as part of the curriculum and/or the study regulations or 
* in certain professional (training) orientations.

In an agricultural or forestry establishment, accidents can be considered work accidents if they do not occur directly while performing the insured employment.
Depending on the protected group of people, the following tasks are covered by accident insurance:
* working in the household of the owner of the company and/or the employee, if the household serves the company to a considerable extent
* working in connection with providing accommodation for guests 
* secondary occupations for the sale of agricultural products from the farm
* working in the context of erecting, converting and repairing buildings that serve the agricultural and forestry establishment
* working in the context of neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural and forestry establishment  

Certain accidents are considered the same as work accidents and in many cases can also affect people who do not have accident insurance.
Accidents that occur in one of the following situations, among others, are considered to be work accidents outside of professional activity:
* for activities with which services from the Unemployment Insurance Act / Labor Market Promotion Act are being made use of (e.g. on the way to an arranged job interview)
* when assisting with an accident or donating blood
* when receiving training, taking part in exercises or serving as a member of one of the following aid organisations:
    * Volunteer fire brigade
    * Volunteer water rescue service
    * Volunteer rescue organisations
    * Austrian Red Cross
    * Austrian Alpine Rescue Service
    * Austrian Water Rescue
    * Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade
    * Avalanche warning committees
    * Air rescue service
    * Radiation detection and survey crews

The employees must inform the employer immediately of:
* any work accident
* any incident that would almost have led to an accident
* any serious and immediate risk to safety and health that they discover
* any defect discovered in protection systems.

The employer must, in turn, immediately report any work accident that leads to a fatality or serious injury to the Labour Inspectorate, if it has not been reported to the emergency services.

Independent of this, every work accident in which a person with accident insurance has been killed, or injured in such a way that they are unable to work for three days, in full or in part, must be reported to the responsible accident insurance provider within five days.

As a self-employed person, please ensure that you not only report accidents involving people you employ but also those that involve you to the accident insurance provider in good time.

Students and schoolchildren should report accidents to the competent directorate.
Schools, educational facilities and universities are obliged to report every work accident through which a person with accident insurance is physically injured or killed within a maximum of five days to the responsible accident insurance provider in triplicate.

In the case of private insurance, the insured party must report an accident in writing immediately in line with the conditions and to avoid the provider from being released from the obligation to perform.
If there are fatalities, this must be reported within three days, even if the accident has already been reported.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="https://example.org/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ReportingParties" name="Accident reporting parties" processRef="Process_WorkAccidentReporting"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsurance" name="Responsible accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Directorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsurer" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LabourInspectorate" name="Serious or fatal accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AccidentInsurance_General" name="Report qualifying insured work accident" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceGeneral" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AccidentInsurance_SelfEmployed" name="Report accident involving self-employed person or employees" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceSelfEmployed" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AccidentInsurance_School" name="School accident report in triplicate" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceSchool" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Directorate" name="Student or schoolchild accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="Participant_Directorate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateInsurer_Accident" name="Written accident report" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateInsurer_Fatality" name="Fatality report" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurerFatality" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsurer"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkAccidentReporting" name="Work Accident" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_WorkAccident">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employees" name="Employees">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_EmployeeIncident</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InformEmployer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_EmployeeInformed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Employers" name="Employers">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_EmployerReportDuty</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReportLabourInspectorate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_LabourInspectorateReported</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_InsuredPersons" name="Persons with accident insurance">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_InsuredPersonThreshold</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceGeneral</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AccidentInsuranceReportedGeneral</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SelfEmployed" name="Self-employed persons">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_SelfEmployedAccident</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceSelfEmployed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AccidentInsuranceReportedSelfEmployed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Students" name="Students and schoolchildren">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_StudentAccident</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReportDirectorate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_DirectorateReported</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_EducationalInstitutions" name="Schools, educational facilities and universities">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_EducationInstitutionDuty</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceSchool</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AccidentInsuranceReportedSchool</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_PrivateInsuredPersons" name="Privately insured parties">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_PrivateAccidentNoFatality</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReportPrivateInsurer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_PrivateAccidentReported</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_PrivateAccidentWithFatality</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReportPrivateInsurerFatality</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_PrivateFatalityReported</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployeeIncident" name="Employee has a work accident or near accident, or discovers an immediate serious safety or health risk or protection-system defect"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InformEmployer" name="Inform employer immediately"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeInformed" name="Employer informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployeeIncident_Inform" sourceRef="Start_EmployeeIncident" targetRef="Task_InformEmployer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inform_EmployeeEnd" sourceRef="Task_InformEmployer" targetRef="End_EmployeeInformed"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployerReportDuty" name="Fatal or serious work accident not reported to emergency services"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate" name="Report accident to Labour Inspectorate immediately"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LabourInspectorateReported" name="Labour Inspectorate report sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EmployerDuty_Report" sourceRef="Start_EmployerReportDuty" targetRef="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Report_LabourEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="End_LabourInspectorateReported"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_InsuredPersonThreshold" name="Work accident kills a person with accident insurance or makes them unable to work for three days, in full or in part"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceGeneral" name="Report work accident to accident insurance provider within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AccidentInsuranceReportedGeneral" name="Accident insurance provider report sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsuredThreshold_Report" sourceRef="Start_InsuredPersonThreshold" targetRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceGeneral"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Report_GeneralInsuranceEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceGeneral" targetRef="End_AccidentInsuranceReportedGeneral"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" name="Accident involves a self-employed person or a person they employ"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceSelfEmployed" name="Report accident to accident insurance provider in good time"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AccidentInsuranceReportedSelfEmployed" name="Accident insurance provider report sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployedAccident_Report" sourceRef="Start_SelfEmployedAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceSelfEmployed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Report_SelfEmployedEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceSelfEmployed" targetRef="End_AccidentInsuranceReportedSelfEmployed"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StudentAccident" name="Student or schoolchild has an accident"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReportDirectorate" name="Report accident to competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DirectorateReported" name="Competent directorate informed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StudentAccident_Report" sourceRef="Start_StudentAccident" targetRef="Task_ReportDirectorate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Report_DirectorateEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReportDirectorate" targetRef="End_DirectorateReported"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EducationInstitutionDuty" name="Work accident physically injures or kills a person with accident insurance at a school, educational facility or university"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceSchool" name="Report work accident to accident insurance provider in triplicate within five days"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AccidentInsuranceReportedSchool" name="Accident insurance provider report sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EducationDuty_Report" sourceRef="Start_EducationInstitutionDuty" targetRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceSchool"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Report_SchoolInsuranceEnd" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsuranceSchool" targetRef="End_AccidentInsuranceReportedSchool"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PrivateAccidentNoFatality" name="Private insurance accident occurs without fatalities"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" name="Report accident to private insurer in writing immediately under the policy conditions"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateAccidentReported" name="Private insurer accident report sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateAccident_Report" sourceRef="Start_PrivateAccidentNoFatality" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateReport_End" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurer" targetRef="End_PrivateAccidentReported"/>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_PrivateAccidentWithFatality" name="Private insurance accident results in fatalities"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportPrivateInsurerFatality" name="Report fatalities to private insurer within three days, even if the accident has already been reported"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_PrivateFatalityReported" name="Private insurer fatality report sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_Report" sourceRef="Start_PrivateAccidentWithFatality" targetRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurerFatality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatality_End" sourceRef="Task_ReportPrivateInsurerFatality" targetRef="End_PrivateFatalityReported"/>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_AccidentContexts">
      <bpmn:text><![CDATA[Accident-context reference for gathering information:
For insured gainful employment, a work accident can include an accident at a location, time and with a cause related to the insured employment; while working from home; on the direct route between permanent residence and work, to lunch, or home (including carpools); during training providing specific professional knowledge, including the direct route to or from the training centre; on a route from home, workplace or training centre to a doctor and back where it interrupts the direct route to or from work (the doctor's visit must be notified to the employer in advance); on the way to or from work or a training centre to take a child to or collect a child from childcare, daycare, external care or school where the person has supervisory responsibility; or while making use of advocacy groups or professional associations, such as the Chamber of Labour, trade union federation or guild.
For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, a work accident can include an accident related by location, time and cause to the insured school, university or compulsory kindergarten education; during a school or school-related event; on the direct route from the child's residence or permanent accommodation to kindergarten or school and home; while performing a practical task prescribed by the curriculum or study regulations; or in certain professional training orientations.
In agricultural or forestry establishments, covered tasks can include work in the owner's or employee's household where it serves the establishment to a considerable extent; work connected with guest accommodation; secondary occupations selling farm agricultural products; work erecting, converting or repairing buildings serving the establishment; and neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural or forestry establishment.
Accidents outside professional activity can include activities using services under the Unemployment Insurance Act or Labor Market Promotion Act, such as travelling to an arranged job interview; assisting with an accident or donating blood; and training, exercises or service as a member of a volunteer fire brigade, volunteer water rescue service, volunteer rescue organisation, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committee, air rescue service, or radiation detection and survey crew.]]></bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Association_AccidentContexts" sourceRef="Annotation_AccidentContexts" targetRef="Start_EmployeeIncident"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
